_comment: REQUEST FORM, NOT A PERMISSION. JobKorea official XML API (guide V4.1). Filled ONLY from JobKorea's own API approval (the approval email / account notice JobKorea sent). Stored ONLY at C:\dev\crawler-data\secrets\t61\ (never in Git). provider = JobKorea (never the PM). evidence_sha256 = SHA-256 of the saved approval email (.eml/.pdf). allowed_url_prefixes = the endpoint's public form (scheme://host/path, NO query: the account parameters stay in the API config file). Separate from the WEB (HTML) permission: allowed_methods API admits only the XML API. As-is the empty fields refuse every request (PROVIDER_EVIDENCE_MISSING). Policy: docs/data/T61_PM_APPROVAL_POLICY.md
